description: This file defines an abstract class 'StaticContentFile' that extends 'ContentFile'. It provides getter and setter methods for the 'fileContentType' property, which is of type 'FileContentType'.

classes.name: StaticContentFile
classes.description: An abstract class representing a static content file with a specific content type, extending 'ContentFile'.

methods.name: getFileContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the static content file.

methods.name: setFileContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the static content file.
